action: press 'Up' -- move the selection off the ready-made characters and onto the one I fill in myself
commentary: There is a rack of people already made up in here and I am not any of them. Up one, to the one where I answer the questions myself.

action: press 'Return' -- take the entry that lets me fill myself in by hand
commentary: Right. Let us see what I look like written down.

action: press 'f' -- finish the world settings as the engine offered them
commentary: Fairport Harbor. I have run gear out of a dozen towns with a name like that. I did not pick this world, I only woke up in it, so I will take it as it stands.

action: press 'Y' -- answer the case-sensitive confirmation with the capital it wants
commentary: Yes. I am finished deciding about the shape of the world. Nothing about it is mine to argue with.

action: press 'shift+Tab' -- step back to the points page before I choose anything about myself
commentary: Before I answer anything I want to see what the answers cost. Show me the ledger first.

action: press 'Down' -- move down off the no-limits budget onto the one with separate pools
commentary: A version of me with no limits is not a person, it is a wish. Down one.

action: press 'Return' -- take the budget where every gain has to be paid for somewhere else
commentary: That is how it has always worked. If I am strong in one place I am paying for it in another, and I would rather see the bill than pretend there is not one.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on to where this starts
commentary: Right. Now where does this begin.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search on the list of starts
commentary: There is a long list here and I already know which one is mine.

action: press 'm' -- begin spelling the start I am looking for
commentary: M.

action: press 'i' -- keep spelling it
commentary: I.

action: press 's' -- finish spelling it
commentary: S. Missed. That is the honest word for what happened to me.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see what is left of the list
commentary: Show me what is left when I ask for that.

action: press 'Return' -- take the start that matches what actually happened to me
commentary: I did not get out. I was on the water when it started and I came back to a harbour nobody was managing any more, so this is the honest one to take.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on to what I actually am
commentary: That is settled then. Now the trade.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search on the trades
commentary: I know the answer to this one without reading the list.

action: press 'f' -- begin spelling my trade
commentary: F.

action: press 'i' -- keep spelling it
commentary: I.

action: press 's' -- keep spelling it
commentary: S.

action: press 'h' -- finish spelling it
commentary: H. Fisher. Thirty-one seasons of it.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see what is left
commentary: Show me.

action: press 'Return' -- take the trade I actually have
commentary: Thirty-one seasons. A rod, a knife on my hip, waders, and my father's wrist watch, which is the only thing on that list I would fight to keep.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on from the trade
commentary: That is me on paper. What else do they want.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search on the other things I am
commentary: There are two habits I am not going to pretend about, and they are both on this page.

action: press 'n' -- begin spelling the first of them
commentary: N.

action: press 'i' -- keep spelling it
commentary: I.

action: press 'c' -- finish spelling it
commentary: C. Nicotine. Since I was nineteen.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see what is left
commentary: Show me.

action: press 'Return' -- take the habit I have had since I was nineteen
commentary: I have smoked since I was nineteen and I am not going to stand here and pretend it is under control. It earns me a point and it will cost me a headache when the cigarettes run out.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search again for the other habit
commentary: And the other one.

action: press 'c' -- begin spelling it
commentary: C.

action: press 'a' -- keep spelling it
commentary: A.

action: press 'f' -- keep spelling it
commentary: F.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see the two that match
commentary: Show me both of them.

action: press 'Down' -- move off the extreme version of it onto the plain one
commentary: No. I drink it black and I drink a lot of it, but I have never gone strange from it. The one under it.

action: press 'Return' -- take the plain coffee habit
commentary: Black, and too much of it, for thirty-odd years. When it runs out I will have a head like a bell for two days and then I will be fine.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search once more, to take something off the list
commentary: There is one on there that is not true of me.

action: press 'BackSpace' -- rub out the old search; nothing on the screen changed
commentary: Clear that out first.

action: press 'h' -- type over the selected search text instead of trying to rub it out
commentary: H. Over the top of it, then.

action: press 'i' -- keep spelling it
commentary: I.

action: press 'g' -- finish spelling it
commentary: G. High school.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see what it found
commentary: Show me.

action: press 'Return' -- take the schooling back off the list, because I never had it
commentary: I left school at sixteen for the boats. I have felt the lack of it my whole life and I am not going to write myself a diploma now to make the page look better.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search for the one piece of paper I do have
commentary: There is one licence on that list I have actually held in my hand.

action: press 'b' -- type over what the box is holding
commentary: B.

action: press 'o' -- keep spelling it
commentary: O.

action: press 'a' -- finish spelling it
commentary: A. Boating.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search
commentary: Show me.

action: press 'Return' -- take the boating licence, because I have held one for nine years
commentary: Nine years with my own boat under me. Forty-two feet of nineteen seventies fiberglass and a diesel I rebuilt twice with my own hands. It costs nothing to say so and it is the truest line here.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on to the honest part
commentary: Now the part where I put a number on myself.

action: press 'plus' -- put strength up where it belongs
commentary: Thirty-one years of hauling traps over a gunwale. This is the one thing on this page nobody who has seen me work would argue with.

action: press 'plus' -- and once more
commentary: I can still put a full trap on the rail without thinking about it. Ten, and that is the top of what I will claim.

action: press 'Down' -- move down past the hands
commentary: My hands are ordinary. I have never been quick, only steady, and steady is not on this list.

action: press 'Down' -- and down again, to the schooling I never had
commentary: Here is where I pay for the boats.

action: press 'minus' -- take a point off the book-learning, which I never had
commentary: I left school at sixteen for the boats and I have felt the lack of it ever since. Anything that comes out of a book comes to me slowly and I would rather say so than pretend.

action: press 'Down' -- move down to what I got instead
commentary: And here is what I got instead of schooling.

action: press 'plus' -- put my eyes up where they actually are
commentary: I can read a change in the water at half a mile. It is the only talent I would ever claim out loud.

action: press 'plus' -- and once more, and that is the last of it
commentary: I notice things before I have decided to. Ten, and I will not gild it past that.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on to what is wrong with me, and what is right
commentary: Now the part I have been putting off. I would rather know my own weight than flatter myself.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search on the list of what I am
commentary: Start with the thing that will put me on the floor.

action: press 'b' -- begin spelling the first honest thing
commentary: B.

action: press 'a' -- keep spelling it
commentary: A.

action: press 'c' -- keep spelling it
commentary: C.

action: press 'k' -- finish spelling it
commentary: K. My back.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see it written down
commentary: There it is, in a list, like a diagnosis.

action: press 'Return' -- take the back, because it is the truest thing about me
commentary: Six years of it. There is a way of lifting with a twist that will put me on the deck, and I know exactly what it is, and I still do it when I am tired.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search again
commentary: And the other thing I have always known about myself.

action: press 's' -- type over the old search
commentary: S.

action: press 'l' -- keep spelling it
commentary: L.

action: press 'e' -- keep spelling it
commentary: E.

action: press 'e' -- keep spelling it
commentary: E again.

action: press 'p' -- finish spelling it
commentary: P. How I sleep.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see what it found
commentary: Show me.

action: press 'Return' -- take the sleeping, which was a mercy on the boat and will not be one now
commentary: I slept in a bunk over a running diesel for thirty-one years. I have never once woken up to a noise, and out here that is going to be a problem.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search once more
commentary: One more honest thing, and then the other column.

action: press 'a' -- type over the old search
commentary: A.

action: press 'd' -- keep spelling it
commentary: D.

action: press 'd' -- keep spelling it
commentary: D again.

action: press 'i' -- keep spelling it
commentary: I.

action: press 'c' -- keep spelling it
commentary: C.

action: press 't' -- finish spelling it
commentary: T. It runs straight down my mother's side of the family.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see what it found
commentary: Show me.

action: press 'Down' -- move off the resistant one, which I am plainly not
commentary: That is the wrong way round. I am not the resistant kind and never have been.

action: press 'Return' -- take the streak that runs in my family
commentary: The boats ran on coffee and cigarettes and I have never pretended either was under control. It cost me one thing I loved already and I am not going to write it out of me now.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search for the other column
commentary: Now the things that are right with me. There are fewer of them and I will not pad the list.

action: press 't' -- type over the old search
commentary: T.

action: press 'o' -- keep spelling it
commentary: O.

action: press 'u' -- keep spelling it
commentary: U.

action: press 'g' -- keep spelling it
commentary: G.

action: press 'h' -- finish spelling it
commentary: H. I do not break easily.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see what it found
commentary: Show me.

action: press 'Return' -- take the toughness, which is thirty-one seasons and not a gift
commentary: I have been thrown against a gunwale in a February swell and gone back to work the same afternoon. That is not courage, it is just what I am built out of.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search again
commentary: Next.

action: press 's' -- type over the old search
commentary: S.

action: press 't' -- keep spelling it
commentary: T.

action: press 'o' -- keep spelling it
commentary: O.

action: press 'm' -- finish spelling it
commentary: M. My stomach.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see what it found
commentary: Show me.

action: press 'Up' -- move up off the weak one
commentary: No. The opposite of that, in fact.

action: press 'Up' -- and up again, to the one that is true
commentary: There. That one.

action: press 'Return' -- take the stomach that has never once betrayed me
commentary: I have eaten what was available my whole working life -- bait-box sandwiches, three-day chowder, whatever was in the galley -- and it has never once come back up on me.

action: press 'slash' -- open the search for the last of them
commentary: One more, and it is the one people always get wrong about me.

action: press 'p' -- type over the old search
commentary: P.

action: press 'a' -- keep spelling it
commentary: A.

action: press 'c' -- keep spelling it
commentary: C.

action: press 'k' -- finish spelling it
commentary: K. What I can carry.

action: press 'Return' -- close the search and see what it found
commentary: Show me.

action: press 'Return' -- take the packing, which is a lifetime of stowing gear in a small boat
commentary: Everything on a forty-two foot boat has one place it goes and one way it goes there. My back will still make me pay for the weight, but I know how to stow it.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on to what I can actually do
commentary: That is the whole of what I am. Now what I can do with it.

action: press 'Down' -- start down the list of things a person can be good at
commentary: Bashing things with a stick is not a trade. Past it.

action: press 'Down' -- down again, onto getting out of the way
commentary: Knives are for fish and rope. Here is the one that has actually kept me alive.

action: press 'plus' -- buy the getting out of the way
commentary: Thirty-one seasons teaches you that the sea does not care how much you want to be finished, and that what kills people out there is being in a rush. I do not fight things. I step aside and let them go past.

action: press 'Down' -- keep going down, past the fighting
commentary: Dodging reads two now. Past the hand-to-hand.

action: press 'Down' -- past the spears as well
commentary: Nor that.

action: press 'Down' -- and past fighting with my hands
commentary: I have never hit anybody in my life and I am not going to start claiming I know how.

action: press 'Down' -- past the bows
commentary: The bar is on unarmed now. No.

action: press 'Down' -- past the handguns
commentary: Archery. My father would have laughed.

action: press 'Down' -- past the pistols
commentary: There was a flare pistol in the locker and that is the whole of my education in firearms.

action: press 'Down' -- past whatever a launcher is
commentary: Launchers. I would not know which end to hold.

action: press 'Down' -- past the marksmanship
commentary: Marksmanship. No.

action: press 'Down' -- past the rifles
commentary: Rifles. No.

action: press 'Down' -- past the shotguns
commentary: A man two slips down from me kept one on his boat. I thought it was a foolish thing to have on the water.

action: press 'Down' -- past the machine guns
commentary: Whatever a submachine gun is, it is not mine.

action: press 'Down' -- past the throwing
commentary: I can throw a line. That is not the same thing and I will not pretend it is.

action: press 'Down' -- past the science
commentary: Applied science. That is for people who stayed in school.

action: press 'Down' -- past the wiring
commentary: I can rewire a bilge pump and that is the end of my electrics.

action: press 'plus' -- buy the mending
commentary: Nets, line, canvas, a hull that was half rotten when I bought her. Two years of evenings with resin on my hands and she was sound. This one I have earned.

action: press 'Down' -- move on to the cooking
commentary: Fabrication reads two of mine on top of the one I already had. Next.

action: press 'plus' -- buy the cooking
commentary: Whatever came up in the net, in a pan, with what was in the galley. I have fed a two-person crew on that for nine years and nobody ever complained twice.

action: press 'Down' -- move on down the page
commentary: Food handling is bought. On.

action: press 'Down' -- past the survival, which the trade already gave me
commentary: Five of it came with the trade and that is already more than I would claim. I am not going to buy more of what I have.

action: press 'plus' -- buy the needlework
commentary: Every stitch in my own oilskins is mine. A boat is held together by whoever on board can sew, and on the Marie-Ange that was me.

action: press 'Down' -- on to the swimming
commentary: Tailoring is bought. Next.

action: press 'plus' -- buy the swimming and the wind
commentary: Twice over the side in nine years and twice back aboard, in water that stops your heart if you let it. I am fifty-two and I have no wind for running, but I can still get myself out of the water.

action: press 'Down' -- on down past the computers
commentary: Athletics reads two and two. Two things left that I have actually done.

action: press 'Down' -- and past whatever devices are
commentary: A telephone is a telephone. I do not need a level in it.

action: press 'Down' -- on to the patching-up
commentary: Devices, whatever that means. Past it.

action: press 'plus' -- buy the patching-up
commentary: Fish hooks through a hand, rope burn, a boom to the head, a man with two fingers off. Thirty-one seasons of getting people to the dock in one piece, mostly.

action: press 'Down' -- on to the last one
commentary: Health care is bought. One thing left, and it is the one I am proudest of.

action: press 'plus' -- buy the diesel work
commentary: I rebuilt that diesel twice with my own hands and a manual I could barely read, and she started every morning of the last four seasons. If I can hear a bad bearing I can usually fix it.

action: press 'at' -- put right what it has me down as
commentary: It has me down as a man. I am a woman, fifty-two years of it, and thirty-one of those on a deck where that was the first thing anybody noticed and the last thing that mattered.

action: press 'dollar' -- and dress me accordingly
commentary: And put me in my own clothes while it is at it.

action: press 'a' -- ask it how old I am
commentary: Fifty-two years, and most of them wet.

action: press '5' -- type over the number it guessed
commentary: Five.

action: press '2' -- finish the number
commentary: Two. Fifty-two.

action: press 'Return' -- set my age down
commentary: Fifty-two. Thirty-one seasons out of Gloucester and nine of them on my own boat.

action: press 'n' -- ask it what to call me
commentary: They ought to know what to call me.

action: press 'O' -- begin my given name
commentary: O.

action: press 'd' -- keep spelling it
commentary: D.

action: press 'e' -- keep spelling it
commentary: E.

action: press 't' -- keep spelling it
commentary: T.

action: press 't' -- keep spelling it
commentary: T again.

action: press 'e' -- finish my given name
commentary: E. Odette. Everyone who ever mattered called me Dette.

action: press 'space' -- leave a gap before my father's name; nothing on the screen changed
commentary: And his name after mine.

action: press 'V' -- begin the family name
commentary: V.

action: press 'a' -- keep spelling it
commentary: A.

action: press 'c' -- keep spelling it
commentary: C.

action: press 'h' -- keep spelling it
commentary: H.

action: press 'o' -- keep spelling it
commentary: O.

action: press 'n' -- finish the family name
commentary: N. Vachon. My grandfather brought it down from Riviere-du-Loup in a duffel bag.

action: press 'Return' -- set my name down
commentary: Odette Vachon. Out of Gloucester, and before that out of a duffel bag from Riviere-du-Loup.

action: press 'Tab' -- look over the whole of it before I say yes to it
commentary: Let me see all of it laid out before I sign my name to it.

action: press 'Tab' -- say that this is the whole of me
commentary: Strength ten, hands ordinary, schooling seven, eyes ten. Fifty-two years, five foot nine, A positive. Packmule, strong stomach, tough; addictive, bad back, sleeps like the dead. Survival five, athletics four, and not one weapon on the whole page. That is me, and nothing left over.

action: press 'Y' -- answer the case-sensitive question with the capital it wants
commentary: Yes. Salem is thirty-one miles down the coast and Camille teaches fourth grade in it, and I am not going to find that out from this side of a door.

action: press 'V' -- find out what is in here with me before I move a foot
commentary: Thirty-one seasons taught me to look before I step, and the first thing I want to know in a strange room is whether anything in it is looking back.

action: press 'Escape' -- close the list, having got my answer
commentary: Nothing alive in here but me. That is the best news I am likely to get today, so I will take it and stop looking at golf caps.

action: press 'm' -- look at the chart and find out where in the world I have washed up
commentary: Thirty-one years of reading charts before leaving a mooring. The first thing I want is where the water is.

action: press 'Escape' -- close the chart
commentary: West Rutland. There is not a drop of salt water on this chart, and no coast on it anywhere. Whatever put me here, it put me a long way inland, and Salem might as well be on the moon.

action: press 'bar' -- stand still and listen before I touch anything
commentary: Sit tight and listen. That is most of what fishing ever was, and it has never once been the wrong first move.

action: press 'w' -- choose to wait rather than set the alarm
commentary: My father's watch has an alarm in it and I have not needed one since he died. Waiting is what I want.

action: press '3' -- wait five minutes and listen to the building
commentary: Five minutes. If something in here has heard me it will make itself known in five minutes, and if it has not then I can start moving about like a person instead of a burglar.
